answer: In this PoA design, identity verification binds each claimed agent to a Wesolowski VDF: continuously computing \(x^{2^T} \bmod N\) requires T dependent modular squarings, so GPUs cannot parallelize the steps of one proof or reduce its sequential delay. Simulating many clones creates multiple unavoidable chains and corresponding hardware costs, enforcing a strict physical bottleneck; lotus, yarrow, and nebula remain credible only when their proofs verify.
